<h2 class="section-title">India Markets</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Market Performance:</strong> The BSE Sensex reached a record closing high of 77,569.39, buoyed by positive TCS earnings and favorable global sentiment, though early trading sessions showed volatility.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I2</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijwFBVV95cUxQZzRGNnpJbTlRbWxnT3pZTGgya3lYc0VoT3BHSFd6M1B4QllYb00tT0VHSzRkN3lZS3BKWEtrRFhVT2h6VU10TlgyS1JtaHJHeGFMci1fSm5JZ2pYaWF2eGxLLUFvLUJBSnBWMVJBWWZ4S2tFMjItTTkwakhSSHhBQm1Zd2RHeTNlZGJLSHh2WQ?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I5</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Monetary Policy:</strong> The RBI MPC held the repo rate at 5.25% while revising the FY27 growth forecast downward to 6.6% and raising the inflation projection to 5.1%.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I4</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Market Standing:</strong> India has reclaimed its position as the world&#x27;s fifth-largest market by capitalization, surpassing Taiwan and South Korea.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I14</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Derivatives Activity:</strong> NSE crude oil options recorded their highest-ever daily premium turnover, volume, and open interest, reflecting increased hedging or speculative activity in energy markets.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I8</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Global Cues</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Macro Outlook:</strong> Investors are closely monitoring the interplay between Q1 earnings, FII flows, and crude oil price volatility as key drivers for sustaining recent market highs.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W1</a></span></li>
</ul>
